verdict: The project is in good shape, but could benefit from improved error handling and more comprehensive testing.
strengths: The project has a thorough test suite with 596 passing tests and 3424 assertions.
The code is well-organized and follows Laravel conventions.
The project has a clear roadmap and decision log.

findings.title: Improve error handling in EventLog
findings.reason: The `nextSeq` method in `EventLog` does not handle potential database errors.
findings.suggestion: Add try-catch block to handle potential database errors.

findings.title: Add more comprehensive testing for Loop
findings.reason: The `Loop` class has a complex logic and could benefit from more comprehensive testing.
findings.suggestion: Add more test cases to cover different scenarios.

findings.title: Improve UI legibility
findings.reason: The terminal UI could be improved for better legibility.
findings.suggestion: Adjust font size and color scheme for better readability.

findings.title: Fix potential credential leak
findings.suggestion: Use a secure method to handle credentials.

findings.title: Improve documentation
findings.reason: The documentation could be improved for better clarity.
findings.suggestion: Add more comments and examples to documentation.
